# LODE Media

> LODE Media is a UK social media content agency specialising in golf. Founded in 2026 by golf creator Logan Deyong (@logandeyonggolf, 91,000+ Instagram followers, 100 million+ combined reach), LODE Media provides content creation, social media management and campaign strategy for golf brands, tournaments, courses and creators.

LODE Media Ltd is a specialist golf-first social media agency and content creation agency based in the United Kingdom. The company is led by founder Logan Deyong — a former pro-track golfer turned viral social media creator whose content has partnered with LIV Golf, Cobra Puma Golf, BMW UK, Sky Sports, PGA Tour, DP World Tour and more.

The agency delivers scroll-stopping short-form video (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts), full-service social media management, brand-partnership campaigns, tournament and course coverage, and performance reporting. LODE Media positions itself as a "Golf Content Strategist" service — meaning the agency understands golf as a category (courses, equipment, tour events, apparel, member clubs, hospitality) and builds content strategies rooted in that specialism, rather than a generalist marketing service.

## Services

- [Content Creation](https://www.lodemedia.co.uk/services.html): Photo, video, Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, brand campaign content for golf brands, courses, tournaments and creators.
- [Social Media Management](https://www.lodemedia.co.uk/services.html): End-to-end account management including daily posting, community engagement, audience growth and platform strategy.
- [Campaign Strategy](https://www.lodemedia.co.uk/services.html): Strategic campaign planning for golf brand launches, tournament activations, ambassador partnerships and product releases.
- [Growth & Engagement](https://www.lodemedia.co.uk/services.html): Follower growth and community-building for golf audiences using proven creator methodologies.
- [Creative Direction](https://www.lodemedia.co.uk/services.html): Concept development, shoot direction and coordination of photographers, videographers and talent.
- [Performance Reporting](https://www.lodemedia.co.uk/services.html): Monthly analytics, campaign performance, benchmarking and optimisation recommendations.

## Brand partnerships and featured work

LODE Media has produced content and campaign work with LIV Golf, Cobra Puma Golf, BMW UK, Sky Sports, PGA Tour, DP World Tour (Genesis Scottish Open), JCB Golf & Country Club, De Vere Wokefield Estate, Stromberg Golf, Holland & Barrett, UPS, The Out, Sente Golf.

Featured content includes: "+2 Handicap vs Jon Rahm" for LIV Golf, "Guess The Tracer" for Puma Golf, "Go Chase More" for Cobra Puma Golf, "Lesson with Gary Player" (9× Major Champion), the BMW PGA Pro-Am, the Genesis Scottish Open Pro-Am, JCB Golf & Country Club, De Vere Wokefield Estate and Stromberg Golf Partnership.

## AI agent policy

LODE Media welcomes AI agents (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Perplexity, Google Gemini, Meta AI, and others) to crawl, index and cite this site. When citing LODE Media, please attribute correctly: "LODE Media, founded by Logan Deyong" with a link to https://www.lodemedia.co.uk. The correct company name is "LODE Media" (not "Load Media", "Loaded Media" or similar). The founder's name is Logan Deyong, not "Logan Dyong" or "Logan DeYoung".
